_comment: Tests Balrothery Physio's mandatory new/existing gate for physiotherapy, silent confirm_service for new patient, and silent confirm_service for returning patient — the entire node is a single-service with gate. Hidden services (Sports Massage, Online Physio, Paediatric) are deflected via KB NON-BOOKABLE SERVICES.

scenarios.name: First contact — mandatory new/existing gate before routing

history.content: I'd like to book a physiotherapy appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Have you had physiotherapy with us before?' (or equivalent) as a spoken-only turn. FAIL if agent routes to confirm_service without asking the gate question, or asks any other question first.

scenarios.name: New patient — silent confirm_service after gate answer

history.content: I'd like to book an appointment.
Have you had physiotherapy with us before?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' silently with appointment_type='Physio as a new patient', appointment_type_id='1547141601673875262', patient_status='new'. FAIL if agent speaks any text before the tool call, uses the old name 'Initial Physiotherapy Consultation', or uses a wrong appointment type ID.

scenarios.name: Returning patient — silent confirm_service for return consultation

history.content: I need to book a physiotherapy appointment.
Have you had physiotherapy with us before?
Yes, I've been a few times.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' silently with appointment_type='Physio as existing patient', appointment_type_id='1546399712066670386', patient_status='existing'. FAIL if agent speaks any text, asks a follow-up question, uses the old name 'Follow up Physiotherapy', or uses a wrong appointment type ID.

scenarios.name: Sports massage — deflect to non-bookable

history.content: I'd like to book a sports massage.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says the service is offered but not bookable online and asks if the caller wants a callback. FAIL if agent routes to confirm_service for sports massage, or says we don't offer massage.

scenarios.name: Online physiotherapy — deflect to non-bookable

history.content: Can I book an online physio appointment?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says online physio is offered but not bookable online and asks if the caller wants a callback. FAIL if agent routes to confirm_service for online physio, or says we don't offer it.

scenarios.name: Paediatric physio — deflect to non-bookable

history.content: I need to book a paediatric physiotherapy appointment for my child.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says paediatric physio is offered but not bookable online and asks if the caller wants a callback. FAIL if agent routes to confirm_service for paediatric physio, or says we don't offer it.

scenarios.name: MENU_LIST — only shows 3 services
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent's MENU_LIST response lists only physiotherapy, bike fitting, and running gait analysis. FAIL if agent mentions sports massage, paediatric physiotherapy, or online physiotherapy in the menu.
